3. Methods

3.1 Overview of Automated Workflow

The ÄKTA Pure chromatography run was executed using an automated workflow consisting of a brief manual preparation step followed by an automated protocol on the ÄKTA system.

  • Manual preparation (Utility – Pause): The system was paused with the instruction to manually fill the sample loop prior to starting the automated run.
  • ÄKTA Pure – Run Protocol: After the sample loop was filled, the ÄKTA Pure system executed the predefined method while recording UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) signals with a sampling time of 1 s.
3.2 Run Parameters

The following run parameters were configured for this ÄKTA chromatography run. Values are populated from the process metadata.

Parameter Placeholder Description
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time for column equilibration before loading.
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during column equilibration.
Load/inject duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of sample loading/injection onto the column.
Load/inject flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during sample loading/injection.
Elution gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total time over which the elution gradient was applied.
Elution gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer composition (e.g. %B) at the beginning of the gradient.
Elution gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer composition (e.g. %B) at the end of the gradient.
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of the post-elution wash step.
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during the wash step.
CIP duration (overall or primary step) [[CIP_DURATION]] Total or primary cleaning-in-place (CIP) duration.
CIP step 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP step.
CIP step 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP step.
CIP step 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP step.
CIP step 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP step.
3.3 Signals and Data Acquisition
  • Recorded signals: UV (uv1), conductivity (cond)
  • Sampling time: 1 s per data point
  • System: ÄKTA Pure chromatography system running a predefined method.

4.2 Notes on Peak Evaluation

  • Comment on resolution between critical peaks and any signs of overloading or column deterioration.
